description: Obs-meta trace completeness (PR #1111 / Obs-Meta + Trace-IDs Mega-PR, 5ead9b7cd). Four panels surface the schedd gauge `schedd_operator_action_trace_completeness_ratio{kind}` (set by `pkg/sched/operator_intent_completeness.go::observeOperatorIntentCompleteness` on a 60s tick). CRITICAL: every query filters on `schedd_…` because the gauge IS registered on every daemon (`pkg/wire/metrics.go:3150-3173`) but ONLY schedd's driver calls Set — cross-daemon queries mix real values with never-set/zero defaults on other daemons. Pre-instantiation grid (5 verb-oriented kinds): force_park / force_cold_boot / force_restart / park_instance / restart_instance (pkg/wire/metrics.go::operatorIntentKindClosedSet at line 3135). Runtime driver also writes the .outcome variants and instance aliases — 10 entries total (pkg/sched/operator_intent_completeness.go:160-171). Companion alerts: FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLowPage (page, < 0.50 10m), FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLowWarn (warn, < 0.95 30m), FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLoopStalled (info, gauge stale > 180s). All three share family=obs_trace, component=schedd so the alertmanager inhibit rule auto-pairs page+warn. Runbook: docs/runbooks/FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLow.md. Worst-kind stat panel (id 4) consumes the recording rule `obs:operator_action_trace_completeness_ratio:5m` shipped alongside the alerts (`min(...)` + `clamp_min(0.001)`).

panels.title: Operator action trace completeness by kind (5m)
panels.description: Per-kind ratio time series. clamp_min(0.001) protects the y-axis from the WithLabelValues zero default before the driver's first pass. The vacuous-truth default (=1.0 for absent kinds) means a kind without traffic reads 1.0 here — Panel 2 (audit write rate) is the disambiguator (same precedent as FaasAuditRetentionTableGrowingFasterThanPruned's `volume_rate > 0` precondition at faas.rules.yml:463-469). Threshold bands: green >= 0.95, yellow 0.50-0.95, red < 0.50.

panels.title: Operator action audit write rate by kind (denominator)
panels.description: Stacked topk(8) of audit-write successes across the closed verb-oriented kinds. Counterpart to Panel 1 — a kind whose gauge sits at 1.0 with non-zero write rate is a real completeness violation; a kind whose gauge sits at 1.0 with flat write rate is a vacuous-truth default.

panels.title: Driver loop freshness (s, healthy <180)
panels.description: time() - timestamp(schedd_operator_action_trace_completeness_ratio). Green < 180s (3x the 60s tick), yellow 180-360s, red >= 360s. Same logic as FaasAuditRetentionLoopStalled (26h vs 24h cadence slack — faas.rules.yml:421). Companion alert: FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLoopStalled (info-tier).

panels.title: Worst-kind completeness ratio
panels.description: min(schedd_…) across all kinds — the recording rule `obs:operator_action_trace_completeness_ratio:5m` shipped alongside the alerts. Threshold bands: green >= 0.95, yellow 0.50-0.95, red < 0.50. Same thresholds as FaasOperatorActionTraceCompletenessLowPage / LowWarn.
